title: General.
officialText:
A potable water supply system shall be designed, installed and maintained in such a manner so as to prevent
contamination from nonpotable liquids, solids or gases being introduced into the potable water supply through cross-connections or
any other piping connections to the system. Backflow preventer applications shall conform to Table 608.1, except as specifically
stated in Sections 608.2 through 608.16.10.
